content:
Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. Nordic Semiconductor nRF54LC10A specifications CPU Arm Cortex-M33 @ 128 MHz with DSP, FPU, MPU, and TrustZone 128 MHz RISC-V coprocessor (VPR) with I/O acceleration for SoftPeripherals and time-critical offload Performance – 239 CoreMark/mA, 503 CoreMark (preliminary) Memory – 192 KB RAM Storage – Up to 1012 KB NVM Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 LE with direction-finding, Bluetooth Mesh, etc. Ready for future Bluetooth releases Bluetooth Channel Sounding support for [...]
